# JD Mall

> > JD Mall (mall.jd.com) - Official flagship store marketplace featuring sports equipment, electronics, home goods, and office supplies from brands like AQ, Delixi, and Deli on China's leading e-commerce platform.

JD Mall hosts official brand flagship stores and marketplace sellers offering diverse product categories with advanced filtering options for materials, colors, and prices. The platform is part of JD.com (京东), China's largest retailer and Fortune 500 company.

## Key Topics

- JD.com (京东)
- Flagship stores
- Sports protective gear
- Athletic equipment
- E-commerce product catalogs
- Material filters (EVA, PU, cotton, polyester)
- AQ brand athletic support
- Audio equipment and headphones
- Electrical products and switches
- Office supplies and stationery
- Price and color filtering
- Wrist guards and leg sleeves
- HiFi audio systems
- Circuit breakers and sockets
